sentence_stem: Had the committee been informed earlier,
correct_completion: the project would have been approved last spring.
full_sentence: Had the committee been informed earlier, the project would have been approved last spring.
acceptable_variants: the project would certainly have passed.
the budget would have been secured earlier.

options.text: so the project is delayed now.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a consequence of an actual fact, but the inverted conditional stem requires a hypothetical past result.
'Although' introduces a concession, which does not fit a hypothetical conditional clause starting with 'had'.

options.text: the project would have been approved last spring.
unless the project had been cancelled.
options.why_wrong: 'Unless' sets up a new negative condition, which clashes with the condition already expressed by the inverted 'had' structure.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional (Had + subject + past participle, followed by would have + past participle)
explanation: The inverted 'had' replaces 'if', so the main clause must express the hypothetical past result using 'would have' plus a past participle.
